Spirit

Biography

The Spirit is the dead scientist summoned by Kholai. Speaking in broken phrases, it describes the horror that pursued the young Joon and the transformation and teleportation used to hide him. The testimony is fragmentary and painful for the spirit; Kholai supplies the interpretation that guides Zak’s next search. [1, 2]
